request.style: English, Baroque closing chorus, full mixed choir and orchestra with trumpets and timpani, broad slow opening then a running fugue, majestic D major, grand and solemn, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I heard the voice of many angels
Around the throne, ten thousand times ten thousand
And all the living creatures and the elders
Singing with a loud voice

[Chorus]
Worthy is the Lamb who was slain
To receive power and riches and wisdom
And strength and honor and glory and blessing
Worthy is the Lamb

[Verse]
To him who sits upon the throne
And to the Lamb
Be blessing and honor and glory and power
Forever and ever

[Chorus]
Worthy is the Lamb who was slain
To receive power and riches and wisdom
And strength and honor and glory and blessing
Worthy is the Lamb

[Outro]
Amen, amen
